Synopsis:
August 2026 private PMI surveys show broad Asian manufacturing expansion driven by surging global AI hardware demand. China (51.5), Japan (54.9), South Korea (52.3), Taiwan (54.7) and Philippines (54.9) all remain in expansion. South Korea exports surged +68.7% YoY. Key risk: Middle East conflict elevating costs and uncertainty. Outliers: Indonesia slipped into contraction (49.8); India hit a 5-year low in factory growth with emerging job losses.
